edits.label: translate fields

<CalculatorField
        id="homePrice"
        label="House Price (₹)"
        type="number"
        placeholder="e.g. 5000000"
        required={true}
        min="0"
        step="1"
        helpText="Total purchase price of the House."
      />

      <CalculatorField
        id="downPayment"
        label="Down Payment (₹)"
        type="number"
        placeholder="e.g. 1000000"
        min="0"
        step="1"
        helpText="Amount paid upfront."
      />

      <CalculatorField
        id="loanYears"
        label="Loan Term (Years)"
        type="number"
        placeholder="e.g. 20"
        required={true}
        min="0"
        step="1"
        helpText="Repayment period."
      />

      <CalculatorField
        id="annualRate"
        label="Interest Rate (%)"
        type="number"
        placeholder="e.g. 8.5"
        required={true}
        min="0"
        step="0.01"
        helpText="Annual interest rate."
      />

      <CalculatorField
        id="propertyTaxAnnual"
        label="Property Tax (% of price/year)"
        type="number"
        placeholder="e.g. 1"
        min="0"
        step="0.01"
        helpText="Optional. Leave blank if unknown."
      />

      <CalculatorField
        id="homeInsuranceAnnual"
        label="House Insurance (₹/year)"
        type="number"
        placeholder="e.g. 8000"
        min="0"
        step="1"
        helpText="Optional annual insurance premium."
      />

      <CalculatorField
        id="pmiAnnual"
        label="PMI (% of loan/year)"
        type="number"
        placeholder="e.g. 0.5"
        min="0"
        step="0.01"
        helpText="Applies only if down payment is under 20%."
      />

      <CalculatorField
        id="hoaMonthly"
        label="HOA / Maintenance (₹/month)"
        type="number"
        placeholder="e.g. 1500"
        min="0"
        step="1"
        helpText="Optional monthly society/maintenance fee."
      />
